items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: We had Johnny Dots playing clarinet. ... and myself on bass, and King Oliver was playing. That's the way the band was picked up when we went to Frisco

ctx.x: David Jones playing alto, mellophone and sax. We had Johnny Dots playing clarinet. We had Lilian Armstrong on piano. We had Minor Hall on drums, and we had Notre Dutre on trombone, and myself on bass, and King Oliver was playing. That's the way the band was picked up when we went to Frisco, playing at the Procola dance hall.
And when you came west, did you plan to stay here, or did you just come for a short trip? Well, we come to play that engagement, that's all.

items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: Johnny Dots was in New York with us.

ctx.x: Holler at each other, you know. He might do something. Johnny Dotslider would come in a little late or something, and... They'd come on there, you look like old Montutti. What band was that? Kid Horry. Kid Horry, huh? In New York? When was he in New York with Johnny Dots? Johnny Dots was in New York with us. When was that? What year was that? That was... I was, uh...
